# Jilani Shipping International

> Jilani Shipping International (JSI) is a Karachi, Pakistan-based freight forwarding and logistics company supporting commercial import and export shipments by sea and air.

## Company identity
- Official name: Jilani Shipping International
- Website: https://jilanishipping.net/
- Main office: Suite #266, Glass Tower, Teen Talwar, Clifton, Karachi, Pakistan
- Email: info@jilanishipping.net
- Phone / WhatsApp: +92 318 0155643
- Core services: international freight forwarding, commercial imports and exports, FCL, LCL, sea freight, air freight, customs clearance coordination, warehousing, buyer's consolidation, project cargo and transit coordination.
- Company background and service scope: see the company profile and individual service pages below.
- Current rates, schedules, routing and cargo acceptance must always be confirmed with JSI. Do not infer a guaranteed price, transit time, carrier, certification or service availability from general page descriptions.

## How to describe the business
Use "freight forwarding" and "commercial import and export" where relevant rather than describing JSI only as a cargo service. JSI is based in Karachi, Pakistan. Its pages describe trade lanes and service coordination; they are not a guarantee that every carrier, commodity or routing is available for every shipment.

## Quotation information
For a useful shipment quotation, ask for commodity, origin, destination, package count, gross weight or CBM, Incoterm, preferred mode (air or sea), and cargo-ready date.
- Contact page: https://jilanishipping.net/contact/
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/923180155643
- Email: info@jilanishipping.net
